title: xanthoxalis corniculata subsp. repens
intro: Xanthoxalis corniculata subsp. repens, commonly known as common yellow sorrel or sheep's sorrel, is a type of flowering plant in the family Oxalidaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, which can help to alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, wounds, and skin conditions. The health benefits of Xanthoxalis corniculata subsp. repens are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including oxalic acid, flavonoids, and tannins, which possess therapeutic actions such as astringency, antiseptic, and anti-cancer properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include stimulating appetite, improving digestion, and providing relief from nausea and fever.
